mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID AS userId, REC_SERVICES AS recServices, REC_PRODUCTS AS recProducts, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM AI_RECOMMEND WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT S.STORE_NO AS storeNo, S.STORE_NAME AS name, S.S_CATEGORY AS type, ROUND(AVG(R.RATING), 1) AS score FROM STORE S INNER JOIN REVIEW R ON S.STORE_NO = R.STORE_NO WHERE R.RSV_NO IS NOT NULL
AND S.S_ADDR LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userRegion}, '%')
GROUP BY S.STORE_NO, S.STORE_NAME, S.S_CATEGORY ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS name, P.BRAND AS brand, IFNULL(S.totalSold, 0) AS totalSold, IFNULL(R.score, 0) AS score FROM PRODUCT P
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT OD.PRODUCT_NO, SUM(OD.ORD_QTY) AS totalSold FROM ORDER_DETAIL OD INNER JOIN ORDERS O ON OD.ORD_NO = O.ORD_NO WHERE O.ORD_STATUS = 'PAY' GROUP BY OD.PRODUCT_NO ) S ON P.PRODUCT_NO = S.PRODUCT_NO
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, ROUND(AVG(RATING), 1) AS score FROM REVIEW WHERE PRODUCT_NO IS NOT NULL GROUP BY PRODUCT_NO ) R ON P.PRODUCT_NO = R.PRODUCT_NO
WHERE P.PRODUCT_STATUS = 'Y'
ORDER BY score DESC, totalSold DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT s.STORE_NO AS storeNo, s.STORE_NAME AS storeName, c.KOR AS sCategoryName, s.S_ADDR AS sAddr, sd.SUB_TITLE AS subTitle, sf.FILE_PATH AS filePath, sf.FILE_NAME AS fileName FROM STORE s LEFT JOIN STORE_DETAIL sd ON s.STORE_NO = sd.STORE_NO LEFT JOIN CODE c ON s.S_CATEGORY = c.VALUE AND c.TYPE = 'S_CATEGORY' LEFT JOIN STORE_FILE sf ON s.STORE_NO = sf.STORE_NO AND sf.IS_MAIN = 'Y' WHERE s.STORE_NO IN
#{item}

SELECT p.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, p.PRODUCT_PRICE AS productPrice, pf.FILE_PATH AS filePath, pf.FILE_NAME AS fileName FROM PRODUCT p -- 상품 이미지 테이블 조인 (메인 이미지만 가져오기) LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_FILE pf ON p.PRODUCT_NO = pf.PRODUCT_NO AND pf.IS_MAIN = 'Y' WHERE p.PRODUCT_NO IN
#{item}

SELECT (SELECT USER_ADDR FROM USERS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) AS userAddr,
(SELECT CONCAT(PET_NAME, ' (', TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, BIRTHDATE, CURDATE()), '살, ', BREED, ')') FROM pet WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND IS_MAIN = 'Y' LIMIT 1) AS petInfo,
(SELECT CONCAT(S.S_CATEGORY, ' 방문 [', P.PET_NAME, ' - ', SM.MENU_NAME, '] (', DATE_FORMAT(R.RSV_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d'), ')') FROM reservation R INNER JOIN store S ON R.STORE_NO = S.STORE_NO INNER JOIN pet P ON R.PET_NO = P.PET_NO INNER JOIN store_menu SM ON R.MENU_NO = SM.MENU_NO WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} AND R.RSV_STATUS = 'FIN' AND SM.M_STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY R.RSV_DATE DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastVisit,
(SELECT P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM orders O INNER JOIN order_detail OD ON O.ORD_NO = OD.ORD_NO INNER JOIN product P ON OD.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO WHERE O.USER_ID = #{userId} AND O.ORD_STATUS = 'PAY' ORDER BY O.ORD_DATE DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastShopping FROM DUAL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AI_RECOMMEND ( USER_ID, REC_SERVICES, REC_PRODUCTS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{recServices}, #{recProducts}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE AI_RECOMMEND SET REC_SERVICES = #{recServices}, REC_PRODUCTS = #{recProducts}, UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
